Name: Sunroom Greenhouse
Author: Sharogg
Description:
Replaces the vanilla greenhouse map with this custom map which is inspired by Caroline's Sunroom. There are three greenhouse options available. Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]﻿ to configure in-game.

Added dependency on my tilesheet mod: the reason for this is to make it more compatible with recolours, as I included a toned down version there and I didn't want to add recolour options in every mod where I use this tilesheet. The previous version will remain available.

[b]Features:[/b]

[list]
[*]The large version has a 15x10 crop area, a pool to the left to replenish energy and lots of space to the left and right which can be used for trees, garden pots, kegs or decoration to create a nice area. On the left another crop patch (7x7) can optionally be added.
[/list][list]
[*]The small version also has a 15x10 crop area and some space around for trees like the vanilla greenhouse.
[/list][list]
[*]Both options come with an optional caskable cellar with plenty of space and a radio to change the music (like a jukebox). The cellar can be configured to unlock after the third house upgrade (default) or be there from the start.
[/list][list]
[*]The greenhouse is quite heavily decorated in Caroline's Sunroom style. If you prefer a clean look then this mod probably isn't for you.
[/list][list]
[*]The greenhouse walls are transparent and feature a background which changes according to the season.
[/list]
[b]Updates:
[/b]
[list]
[*]A taller version with twice the crop area is now available (otherwise like the small version)
[*]The small and tall versions now have an optional spa area which can be reached through a door
[*]It is now possible to warp to the farmhouse cellar instead of adding an extra cellar (when in cellar, walk on the left of the stairs to warp to greenhouse, and on the right to warp to farmhouse)
[*]If you want the extra cellar, but want the ability to warp between the cellars, an optional magic warp is now available
[*]The sprinkler spots can now be turned off
[*]Two additional background options added - panorama (requires DaisyNiko's Tilesheets) and water
[/list]
[b]Compatibility[/b]
[list]
[*]1.6+ compatible
[*]Should be compatible with recolours, but changes to the caroline's sunroom tilesheet will not be applied to the greenhouse, as it uses its own version.
[*]Not compatible with other mods which change the greenhouse.
[*]Cellar warping options might not be compatible with custom cellars or farmhouses (feel free to request a compatibility patch)
[/list]
[b]Credits:[/b]
DaisyNiko for their indoor [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736]tilesheet [/url]﻿and for the cellar design in their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3969]Oasis Greenhouse [/url]﻿which heavily inspired my cellar design.

[b]Installation:[/b]
Unzip the mod and paste it into Stardew Valley's Mods folder. Requires SMAPI and Content Patcher. Compatible with 1.6.
Can be installed in an existing save - but be aware that if you have crops/trees/items in the greenhouse they will be messed up/in the wrong location. I recommend emptying the greenhouse before.
